name: NY-Style Italian Loaf (sample)
notes: A sample recipe to try Yes Chef! with. Crisp thin crust, soft open crumb. If the crust comes out paler than before, add 1 tsp non-diastatic malt or go to 15 g sugar.

steps.title: Mix (no salt, no oil)
steps.detail: Combine both flours, yeast, sugar and water until no dry flour remains. Hold back salt and oil.

steps.title: Add salt, develop gluten
steps.detail: Add salt. Stand mixer on speed 2 until the dough clears the sides of the bowl. By hand: knead 12–15 minutes.

steps.title: Add oil, mix to windowpane
steps.detail: Drizzle in the oil a little at a time and keep mixing until smooth and silky.
steps.check: Windowpane: a thin stretch lets light through without tearing. Dough 76–78°F.

steps.title: Stretch and fold
steps.detail: One set of folds on all four sides. A fully mixed dough needs only one.

steps.title: Divide and preshape
steps.detail: Turn out gently, divide, preshape into loose logs.

steps.title: Bench rest
steps.detail: Rest covered. The longer rest lets you shape without forcing out gas.

steps.title: Shape gently
steps.detail: Same folds as before, but press lightly and seal without flattening. Roll to length with light hands: smooth, not tight. Mist and seed now if using sesame.

steps.title: Final proof (start preheat now)
steps.detail: Proof until almost doubled. Start preheating the oven at the beginning of this step.
steps.check: Floured finger poke ½ inch: fills back slowly, leaves a slight dent

steps.title: Transfer and score
steps.detail: Move proofed loaves to the perforated tray. One confident slash with a fresh razor at 30–45°, about ¼–½ inch deep. Clear a line of seeds first if using sesame.

steps.title: Load and steam
steps.detail: Load the bread. Pour about 1 cup boiling water into the preheated steam pan, keep hands and face clear, close the door promptly.

steps.title: Remove steam, bake at 450°F
steps.detail: Remove the steam pan if safe. Reduce to 450°F and bake until well browned.

steps.title: Dry the bottoms (optional)
steps.detail: If bottoms are pale or soft, bake directly on the rack at 400–425°F.

steps.title: Cool
steps.detail: Cool on a wire rack before slicing. Judge the crumb only after it is fully cool.
